F1_s1.explanation: The unit responds to a tapering, wedge-shaped protrusion that narrows to a small dark rounded tip, usually with a small dark spot set just above or behind it, on smooth warm tan, cream or two-toned surfaces. Weaker responses extend to other elongated, pointed tapering forms, including thin dark ones without the tip-and-spot arrangement.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a tapering, wedge-shaped protrusion that narrows to a small dark rounded tip, usually with a small dark spot set just above or behind it, on smooth warm tan, cream or two-toned surfaces. Weaker responses extend to other elongated, pointed tapering forms, including thin dark ones without the tip-and-spot arrangement.
parsed.evidence: Most of the top 20 boxes sit on a narrowing pointed form with a dark endpoint and a nearby dark spot (#1-8, #10, #11, #13, #15, #16, #18-20), and #9 is a thinner pointed taper at activation 6. Random images without such tapered pointed forms score 0-2, and the weaker hits #12, #14 and #17 fall on less clearly matching regions, so those may be noise.
